task: Add a --print-config dry-run flag to AgentCLI/BaseAgentAdapter that generates the opencode config through the normal beforeRun pipeline, redacts secrets, and prints it to stdout without starting opencode.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: AgentCLI, BaseAgentAdapter, print-config (new), config-redaction (new), types.ts (AgentAdapter/run contract)

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: New secret-redaction pattern with no prior precedent in the codebase; correctness-critical (must not leak apiKey/token/secret/password/authorization when printing generated config); dry-run path must still stop the SSO/JWT proxy server or the process hangs after printing
technical_risk.mitigation: Regex-based recursive redactSecrets() covering common secret key names, applied at print time; try/finally around proxy.stop() in the dry-run branch of BaseAgentAdapter.run(); dedicated unit tests (config-redaction.test.ts, print-config.test.ts, AgentCLI-print-config.test.ts) plus a real-plugin integration test (tests/integration/opencode/print-config.test.ts)

key_reasoning.reason: Adds two new shared core modules (print-config.ts, config-redaction.ts) and extends AgentCLI, BaseAgentAdapter, and the AgentAdapter/run type contract — BaseAgentAdapter is the shared base class inherited by every agent adapter, so this counts as touching core shared utilities.

First secret-redaction utility in the codebase, motivated purely by security (avoid leaking apiKey/token/secret/password when printing config to stdout), plus a dry-run early-return path that must still tear down the SSO/JWT proxy correctly.
11 files changed per diffstat (5 modified, 6 new), spanning both src/ and tests/, maps to the XL band (11-15 files) even though the change itself is additive (469 insertions, only 9 deletions).

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M (3) to L (4): BaseAgentAdapter is a core shared base class extended by every agent adapter — touches core shared utilities.
Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): the feature exists specifically to prevent credential/secret leakage when printing generated config — Security red flag.
